title: Print all k-sum paths in a binary tree
inputFormat:
Implement kSumPaths(root, k). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
Trees use level-order arrays with null for missing children. The editor passes nodes with val, left, and right properties; [] becomes null.
outputFormat:
Return the result described in the statement.
The order of the outer result array does not matter.
